mentions.name: FluxMail
mentions.description: Self-hosted local email infrastructure for agents and apps. It provides an MCP server that gives AI agents access to email, a CLI for interacting with email, and a REST API for building custom email apps, all run and hosted locally on the user's computer. Supports Gmail, Outlook, and IMAP/SMTP, aiming to make email easy to interact with through any chosen interface while giving users control over how they use their email.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on self-hosted local email infrastructure for agents and apps: https://github.com/churichard/fluxmail

It consists of a MCP server, a CLI, and a REST API. Everything is run and hosted locally on your computer.
mentions.author: RichardChu
